errors.observed_error: Three defects made the Windows desktop layer look impossible. (1) The harness called GetClientRect with three arguments (byref(w), byref(h)) against a two-argument API, so the whole RECT landed in the first pointer and width/height were read back as left/top = 0. Every window therefore measured 0x0 and the GDI proof returned windows=0 on a machine where the real main window measures 1280x820 and visible=true. (2) Because (1) kept `found` empty, PrintWindow and GetBitmapBits were never executed on any machine, hiding two further defects: the GDI/DC functions declared argtypes but no restype, so a raw int was passed where wt.HDC was required, and GetBitmapBits received ctypes.byref(c_size_t(n)) where a DWORD value was required - both raise 'argument 2: TypeError: wrong type' the moment the path is finally reached. (3) check_9 probed only shutil.which('cargo') and ~/.cargo/bin/cargo.exe and then asserted 'Windows toolchain not installed' unconditionally, and GATE_SEMANTICS printed 'TAURI_WINDOWS_PENDING=yes(without Rust toolchain)'. That claim is false on this machine and contradicts the repository's own reference (windows-development-environment/references/tauri-build-shared-toolchain.md: 'Never turn a failed path probe into the persistent claim MSVC/Tauri is unavailable'), and register row AG-08 had promoted it to a machine-level blocker ('no Visual Studio and no VC tools at all').
errors.root_cause: Probe scope and dead code paths. The toolchain probe looked only at system PATH and the per-user cargo home, never at the declared shared roots in .project/governance/external-libraries-index.json (os-external), where MSVC 14.44.35207 (cl/link/MSBuild), a complete stable-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc toolchain with rustc.exe, cargo-tauri.exe and tauri-driver.exe all live; the Windows SDK import libraries are on the system volume at C:/Program Files (x86)/Windows Kits/10/Lib/10.0.28000.0/{ucrt,um}/x64. Separately, a Win32 signature error made the GDI branch always return an empty set, so the two downstream ctypes defects were unreachable and stayed latent from the day the harness was written.
errors.fix: Corrected all three at the root. check_9 now resolves cargo through the declared shared roots (external-libraries-index.json sharedRoots + libraries[kind=toolchains].assets[tool=cargo]) after an optional WORKLAB_CARGO override, PATH and ~/.cargo/bin, and performs a real 'cargo --version' readback, reporting the resolved path and version; the false unconditional 'Windows toolchain not installed' string is gone and the pending reason now names what is actually outstanding (desktop WebView2 E2E not executed). GATE_SEMANTICS no longer asserts 'without Rust toolchain'. The harness's GetClientRect now takes (HWND, LPRECT) and is wrapped in _client_size, and the GDI call chain got the restypes it was missing (GetDC/CreateCompatibleDC -> wt.HDC, CreateCompatibleBitmap -> wt.HBITMAP, SelectObject -> wt.HGDIOBJ, GetBitmapBits -> c_ulong, PrintWindow -> c_bool) with the count passed as a value. Positive readbacks from the same round: the shared toolchain compiled and RAN an msvc-target binary with zero downloads (RUSTC_EXIT=0, RUN_EXIT=0, 251,392 B), the Observer built with BUILD_EXIT=0 in 1m30s (app.exe 9,779,712 B, sha256 e659bbe9b20a2677, PE imports api-ms-win-crt-*/dwmapi with no libgcc/libwinpthread), and the app now stays ALIVE against the real sidecar instead of early-exiting 0xC0000135 as the previous GNU artifact did.
errors.regression_test: A Win32 wrapper must declare argtypes AND restype for every handle-returning call, and value parameters must be passed as values; a probe may not report a toolchain as absent unless every declared location in external-libraries-index.json has been probed and its exact path recorded in the evidence.
errors.repeat_prevention: Never record a machine-level blocker from a single-path probe: enumerate the declared shared roots and Windows Kits first and cite the paths attempted. Environment-limited branches must be executed at least once, because a branch that is never reached cannot fail and therefore cannot be trusted.
errors.remaining_boundary: Not yet closed: the real desktop surface proof. CDP over the process-level WEBVIEW2_ADDITIONAL_BROWSER_ARGUMENTS still yields no page target, so the probe window path (per-window additional_browser_args) is inert by architecture - WebView2 creates one browser environment per user-data folder and the main window creates it first. errors.observed_error: The GDI capture rectangle was derived from the comparison 'w * 12 >= WINDOW_LOGICAL_WIDTH_PX * dpi', a typo for * 96. That foreign content made a window painting nothing but its own #08090a background read as 375, 635, 722 and 384 distinct colours across four windows, and a first-cut conclusion that the screen BitBlt had captured the real UI was recorded on that basis before the rectangle was checked.
errors.root_cause: The instrument inferred its coordinate space from a number instead of from the DPI-awareness state it had itself set, and it never bounded the capture rectangle by the client area it had measured microseconds earlier.
